preconditions.description: Length of string S is between 1 and 10^5.
Length of string P is between 1 and 10^5.
All characters in string S are lowercase alphabets.
All characters in string P are lowercase alphabets.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(c in return_value for c in P)
postconditions.description: The returned substring contains all characters of P, or it is '-1' if no such window exists.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or len(return_value) == min(len(window) for window in [S[i:j] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S)+1) if all(c in S[i:j] for c in P)])
postconditions.description: The returned substring is the smallest window containing all characters of P, or it is '-1' if no such window exists.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (len([window for window in [S[i:j] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S)+1) if all(c in S[i:j] for c in P) and len(window) == len(return_value)]) == 1 or return_value == min([S[i:j] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S)+1) if all(c in S[i:j] for c in P) and len(window) == len(return_value)]))
postconditions.description: If there are multiple smallest windows of the same length, the one with the least starting index is returned.
